summary: LocalStorageBackend, registered for CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.LOCAL, composes eight stdlib-only mixins over os/shutil. It implements StorageReadProtocol (LocalReadMixin), StorageWriteProtocol (LocalWriteMixin), StorageEnumerateProtocol (LocalEnumerateMixin), StorageDeleteProtocol (LocalDeleteMixin), StorageMetadataProtocol (LocalMetadataMixin), StorageCopyProtocol (LocalCopyMixin) and StorageDirectoryProtocol (list_dir from LocalListMixin plus mkdir/rmdir from LocalDirectoryMixin); it does not implement RangedReadProtocol. OSErrors are mapped to PathNotFoundError, PermissionDeniedError, StorageConnectionError or StorageError at native call boundaries.
key_classes: LocalStorageBackend — registered local filesystem backend; connect/disconnect are no-ops, is_connected always True
LocalReadMixin — StorageReadProtocol: read_to_bytes, read_to_stream returning a native-backed seekable _LocalReader
LocalWriteMixin — StorageWriteProtocol: bytes and 64 KiB-chunked stream writes, optional parent creation
LocalEnumerateMixin — StorageEnumerateProtocol: exact-path list_objects, recursive or '/'-grouped, skips directory symlinks/junctions when recursing (not in local __all__)
LocalListMixin — list_dir half of StorageDirectoryProtocol; resolves symlinks, skips broken ones
LocalDirectoryMixin — mkdir/rmdir half of StorageDirectoryProtocol; rmdir removes the whole tree (shutil.rmtree)
LocalDeleteMixin — StorageDeleteProtocol: os.remove; missing path raises PathNotFoundError
LocalMetadataMixin — StorageMetadataProtocol: os.stat-based get_metadata, path_exists, get_size
LocalCopyMixin — StorageCopyProtocol: shutil.copy2 with destination parent creation
_LocalReader — private wrapper preserving the native handle's capabilities (seek, readinto, fileno) while mapping OSErrors
key_functions: _helpers._map_local_error(exc, path) -> StorageError | None — OSError classification; leaves io.UnsupportedOperation and shutil.SameFileError native
extension_points: Mixins are plain classes satisfying protocols structurally; they can be recomposed or subclassed to build a custom filesystem-like backend.
Re-registering CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.LOCAL with @register_storage_backend overrides this backend.
lifecycle_notes: No connection: StorageFacade passes connection=None; the backend holds storage_profile but confinement (ROOT_PATH / LocationPolicy) is enforced by the facade, not here.
Pure stdlib; available on the base install without extras.
read_to_stream hands ownership of an open file to the caller; facade random mode returns this same handle instead of a ranged reader.
Writes are not atomic; a failed stream write can leave a partial file.
documentation_hooks: Support matrix row: Local = Read, Write, Enumerate, Delete, Metadata, Copy, Directory; random access via native seekable handle rather than RangedReadProtocol.
Directory semantics divergence: local rmdir is recursive, SFTP rmdir requires an empty directory.
Exact-path enumeration rules (no sibling prefix match, '/' grouping, symlink handling, missing path -> empty result).
Local error mapping and the list_dir migration note (file -> not-directory error, missing -> PathNotFoundError).
examples: examples/local_files/example.py — write, read, metadata, exists, get_size and delete on the local backend
examples/directories/example.py — mkdir, copy, list_dir, delete and rmdir on the local backend
examples/streaming/example.py — gzip write_stream and streamed read on local files
examples/capability_checks/example.py — lists local capabilities via supports()
risks: LocalDirectoryMixin.rmdir uses shutil.rmtree and deletes non-empty trees, unlike SFTP's empty-only rmdir; the protocol leaves this backend-specific (README.md documents it).
LocalDirectoryMixin.mkdir declares `parents` as positional-or-keyword while StorageDirectoryProtocol declares it keyword-only; runtime_checkable isinstance does not detect signature drift.
local __all__ omits LocalEnumerateMixin even though LocalStorageBackend composes it, so star-imports and docs driven by __all__ miss enumeration.
StorageDirectoryProtocol support is split across two mixins (LocalListMixin.list_dir and LocalDirectoryMixin.mkdir/rmdir); neither alone satisfies the protocol.
LocalCopyMixin.copy with an existing directory destination copies into it (shutil.copy2); the facade only guards this when a LocationPolicy is active.
AGENTS.md says local supports 'all but enumerate', contradicting code and tests.

evidence.detail: @register_storage_backend(LOCAL) class LocalStorageBackend(LocalReadMixin, LocalWriteMixin, LocalListMixin, LocalEnumerateMixin, LocalDeleteMixin, LocalMetadataMixin, LocalCopyMixin, LocalDirectoryMixin).
LocalListMixin.list_dir supplies the remaining StorageDirectoryProtocol method.
LOCAL expected set includes all seven storage protocols.
Directory removal backend-specific: Local removes a tree; SFTP removes an empty directory.
Enumeration and parent-creation policy added 2026-10-17; error mapping 2026-10-16; evolving.
